liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (4 reviews): Jerry's vocal is among his finest, ending with moaning that tugs at the heart; The Lovelight into Stella Blue and back to Lovelight sequence is singled out as the show's standout stretch [8][10][11][13]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews, 1 other source): The jam coming out of it has many teases and points ahead to Matilda, which returned that summer; Jerry sang it with a big, emotional, roaring voice [7][8][11]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): The transition from it into Bertha is the one rough spot [13]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): The Lovelight is described as scorching [9]

## The recordings

- **gd94-03-21.sbd.ladner.6258.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 50 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar is solid, but the mix has weak bass and almost inaudible hi-hats; Reviewer insists this tape is not truly a soundboard source; The soundboard is crisp, at a time when many boards sounded dull and muted [13][14][18][19]
- **gd1994-03-21.158173.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 158 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd1994-03-21.140296.set2.dsbd.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 12 songs; 99 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]
- **gd1994-03-21.125739.mtx.eichorn.sbeok.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 164 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Attendee skipped out of a college dorm to see the show in Richfield [11]
- Attendee rushed up to the third row for the Liberty encore [14]
- Deadbase reportedly labeled this the last truly Grateful Dead performance [9]
- Reviewer rates this Stella Blue above the one played at Jerry's birthday show months afterward [9]
- Reviewer says Jerry sounds good for a 1994 show [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-03-21.sbd.ladner.6258.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > SHNv3 [1]
- **gd1994-03-21.158173.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Tapes made for Vince Welnick by Dick Latvala; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 15, 2022; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Scott Clugston applied pitch correction to this transfer [5]
- **gd1994-03-21.140296.set2.dsbd.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Dat > Dat [7]. Also: Second set of the widely circulated soundboard is a cassette generation; Encore Break and Liberty come from a B&K 4011 source [7]
- **gd1994-03-21.125739.mtx.eichorn.sbeok.t-flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Roger Eichorn; source: Matrix of Source 1: SBD > DAT > CDR > SHNv3 and Source 2: AUD Source (handheld/ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB/18th Row) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > TCD-D3 > DAT(m) [2]
